sentences.text: He further submitted that when the statement of the victim was recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. then she also implicated the sister of the applicant and this fact clearly suggests that under the pressure of her parents, she started making allegation against the applicant.

sentences.text: 6. sentences.text: 7. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.
